row.body: A tally sheet groups losses by weapon and vehicle, but the line for who was brought back is empty. One tally has been copied twice.
row.title: Three tallies, no names

sidecar.gloss: An incident tally counts equipment outcomes but leaves returns blank.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could record equipment incidents rather than an official response; the repeated tally does not identify who was lost.
